captions.text: On your shared screen now: “Projectile Motion” and “Setup.”

A point mass m is launched from the origin with speed v naught at angle theta above the horizontal. Gravity acts downward; air resistance is neglected. The two directions are uncoupled, so each equation integrates on its own, and eliminating t gives a parabola through the origin.

Hey, welcome. We’re looking at a derivation for projectile motion. And the setup is a point mass launched from the origin with speed v naught at angle theta above the horizontal. Gravity acts downward, and the horizontal and vertical directions are uncoupled, so each equation integrates on its own. Eliminating t then gives a parabolic trajectory that passes through the origin.
